scope.analysis_scope: Custom — Sunday games kicking off before 2:00 p.m. ET
scope.kickoff_rule: Include Sunday games with scheduled kickoff strictly earlier than 2:00 p.m. ET

historical_sample.label: L20
historical_sample.definition: 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

methodology_overrides.qualification_rule: User explicitly authorized L20 proportional thresholds: main-market HR ≥12/20 OR at least one fixed ladder ≥16/20.
methodology_overrides.conflict_resolution: User explicitly confirmed OR is authoritative over conflicting validation checks that say both thresholds must be met.
methodology_overrides.main_market_selection: The odds source has no main-line indicator. Selected the FanDuel line whose listed over price is numerically closest to -110. This is a transparent proxy, not a source-flagged main line.
